## Target context
- Repo: DontPanic

- Project: (none)

[F014] F014 is complete and verified. The two audit-only harness adapters ship in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/executors/`: `OllamaCLIExecutor` (subprocess `ollama run <model>`, availability via binary probe) and `OpenRouterAPIExecutor` (HTTPS chat completions, availability via `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` env probe), both registered in `AGENT_REGISTRY` under the stable ids `ollama`/`openrouter` — never model version strings, which `test_no_registry_key_is_a_model_version_string` enforces. Each declares `capabilities = frozenset({"non_interactive"})` mirrored in `config.worker_profiles.HARNESS_CAPABILITIES` with a drift test guarding the two surfaces, and implementer dispatch is refused both at resolution (`resolve_worker` capability gate) and in-adapter as defense-in-depth; `gemini_cli` intentionally stays unregistered pending the D001 B2 non-interactive smoke, per the registry comment and capability matrix. Doctor availability probes flow through `get_executor(...).is_available()` (dontpanic_doctor.py:1054), and role-holding rules per harness are documented in `docs/AGENT_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md` (ollama/openrouter: auditor/goal_auditor yes, implementer refused). The targeted suite `test_f014_harness_adapters.py` — 41 tests covering registry stability, capability drift, refusal paths, mocked dispatch success/failure/timeout, transport errors, availability probes, and doc-staleness guards — passes clean (41 passed in 0.22s), with no live API calls required.

$ python3 -m pytest scripts/dont
